profile_text.body:
Cognigy is a Düsseldorf, Germany company whose website presents it as NiCE Cognigy. According to its own site, it powers enterprise customer service with generative and conversational AI agents across voice and chat, and it invites visitors to get a demo or try the product free. The site's messaging centers on deploying AI agents in the contact center to deliver fast, personalized service.

The company is tracked as an enterprise AI platform and agent orchestration product, described as a conversational AI platform for customer service with GDPR compliance and EU-hosted options. Its listed headquarters is Düsseldorf, DE, and its website is cognigy.com.

Beyond the product listing, the held facts record law exposure in Delaware with a count of 24. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded.
